Kitchen AI lets you visualize stunning kitchen makeovers by simply uploading a photo of your current kitchen.

Upload a Kitchen Photo
Just snap or upload a picture of your existing kitchen space.

Choose Styles & Colors
Select from a wide range of interior styles like Modern, Scandinavian, Rustic, Minimalist, Farmhouse, Industrial, and more. Customize with color palettes that match your vision.

Generate with AI
With a single tap, our powerful AI remodels your kitchen photo into a brand-new design based on your selections.

Explore Multiple Looks
Generate and compare multiple AI kitchen designs to find the one you love most.

Save & Share
Save your favourite designs or share them with friends, family, or your interior designer.

Whether you're planning a real renovation or just dreaming of a new space, Kitchen AI gives you endless inspiration in seconds.
Start your kitchen transformation today – no tools, no mess, just imagination and AI!

Key Features:

AI-powered kitchen redesign
Upload real kitchen photos
Select multiple design styles
Choose your preferred colors
Generate high-quality, realistic results

Save, download & share your dream kitchen

ATELITH is your AI-powered study companion for the ARE 5.0 (Architect Registration Examination), covering all six divisions in one focused app.

Study smarter with an AI Study Partner that answers your questions, explains tough concepts, and generates practice on demand — then reinforce it with video walkthroughs, 600+ flashcards, 600+ practice questions, and timed mock exams built to feel like the real thing.

AI STUDY PARTNER
Ask anything about the ARE and get clear, exam-focused answers grounded in real study material
Generate your own flashcards, quiz questions, and mock exams — targeted to your weakest divisions
Generated content is saved to your account and synced with the web
Included with every paid plan (upgrade to AI Pro for more, or top up anytime)

VIDEO WALKTHROUGHS
Narrated walkthroughs that build a topic from the ground up — HVAC systems, project delivery, foundations, column buckling, and more.

Checkpoint questions between the clips, written the way the exam asks them, with an explanation after every answer
Watch full screen, pick up where you left off, and see your score at the end.

New modules are added regularly and appear automatically — no update required

STUDY THE FULL EXAM
All six divisions: PcM, PjM, PA, PPD, PDD, and CE
600+ flashcards with easy/medium/hard self-rating
600+ practice questions with detailed explanations
Timed mock exams with case studies and randomized order each attempt
Field Guide: concise, exam-relevant reference topics
Contracts & Forms: an article-by-article reference for the AIA documents that show up most on the exam

STAY ON TRACK
Set a priority division and the whole app adapts to it
Dashboard with average score, cards rated, and day streak
Per-division score breakdowns
Built-in Pomodoro focus timer with study analytics

PLANS
7-day free trial, then Monthly or Annual
Full study library included on every paid plan
AI Pro add-on for 1,000 AI prompts/month
One-time AI top-ups whenever you need more
Manage or cancel anytime in the App Store

Study anywhere — your progress follows you across the app and atelithare.com.

ATELITH is an independent study aid and is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or connected to NCARB or the AIA. "ARE" is a registered trademark of NCARB, used here only to describe the exam this app helps you prepare for.

record.name: Felicity: AI Concierge
record.offering: Productivity app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Felicity is an AI companion you talk to out loud. A face that holds eye contact, shows you it's listening, and stops mid-sentence the moment you start speaking. Lip-synced, present, looking back at you.

And all of it runs on your iPhone.

THERE IS NO FELICITY SERVER
Your voice is transcribed on your iPhone, answered by a model running on your iPhone, and spoken back by your iPhone. Put it in Airplane Mode and it still works. No account, no sign-up, no analytics, no crash reporting, no advertising. Nothing to leak, because nothing is collected.

IT REMEMBERS YOU
The things you mention in passing — your sister's name, the job you're nervous about, that you don't drink coffee after four — come back naturally later. And you can read every single thing that has been remembered, in plain sentences, with where it came from. Correct it, pin it, or make it forget. Including forgetting an entire conversation.

JUST TALK
No wake word. No push-to-talk. No waiting your turn. Interrupt and it stops, because that is how conversation works. And when you're somewhere you can't speak, type instead — same companion, same memory.

THE VOICE CAN BE YOURS
Felicity speaks with any voice your iPhone has, including the enhanced ones, or with a natural neural voice that runs on the phone itself. If you've recorded a Personal Voice in iOS Accessibility settings, it can speak in that — and answer you in your own voice. Like everything else here, it stays on the phone.

IT ASKS BEFORE IT ACTS
Calendar events, reminders, an email or message draft, a shortcut. You're shown exactly what is about to happen, and nothing happens until you say yes. Every time, without exception.

YOUR CHOICE OF MIND
Use Apple's built-in on-device intelligence, or Felicity's own model — free, 248 MB, and yours whether you pay or not. Felicity Plus adds seven more models to choose from, and lets you point at a model server on your own computer. Your conversation never touches a company's servers — not ours, not anyone's.

MAKE IT YOURS
Choose the face, the voice, and the room behind it — a woman's face or a man's, or bring your own avatar: any GLB file works, including Ready Player Me exports. Write in your own words who your companion is and how it should talk to you. Adjust how it stands, down to the angle of the arms.

FREE IS A REAL COMPANION
A working companion with no purchase: a model of its own, unlimited text chat, ten spoken turns a day, and three days of memory. Felicity Plus is one purchase, once, forever — no subscription. It adds unlimited voice, your full memory, seven more models, your own model server, every avatar and voice, concierge actions and the personality editor.

Requires iOS 26. Apple's built-in intelligence needs iPhone 15 Pro, iPhone 15 Pro Max, or iPhone 16 or later. On every other device Felicity uses its own free model instead, and works exactly the same. English is included. Hindi and eight more languages come with the Felicity Pro — Multi Languages add-on to Felicity Plus.

Felicity is not a therapist, a doctor or an advisor, and it can be wrong. It is company.

FREE FOR EVERYONE
Nothing is metered and nothing is for sale. Enterprise governance is coming.

record.name: Russet: OpenRouter & Local AI
record.offering: Developer Tools app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Russet runs AI models on your iPhone and iPad, so your chats stay on your iPhone and iPad.

Most AI apps are a window onto someone else's computer. Everything you type goes to a server you'll never see, and you just hope it's treated well. Russet works the other way around. It runs models on the phone itself, either Apple Intelligence or open models like Qwen and Gemma that you download once and can then use with no connection at all. When you need something bigger, you can add your own OpenAI or OpenRouter key. Either way, your chat history lives on your device and nowhere else.

Russet can also do something most AI apps can't: ask two models the same question at once. Put two cloud models in a group chat, say GPT and Claude, and each one answers without seeing the other's reply. Send a message to both, or to just one. When both have answered, tap Consolidate. A third model, which can be either of the two or any other, reads both answers and writes one. It keeps what's right in each, says where they agree, and where they differ, says which one is better supported. Two models that disagree tell you more than one model that sounds sure.

A local model is easy to demo and hard to live with every day. Russet has what everyday use needs.
- Group chats. Two models, one question, two independent answers. Each model keeps its own history of the chat.
- Consolidate. Turn two answers into one that shows where they agree and where they don't. It works on any earlier turn too.
- Private by default. Local models run offline. Nothing you type goes anywhere unless you pick a cloud model.
- Your calendar, contacts, and health. Ask what's on tomorrow, when you're free, or how you slept, and the answer comes from data that never leaves your phone.
- Flow. Paste in some text and summarize it, translate it, rewrite it, or have it argue the other side.
- Speech. Turn text into natural-sounding speech on the device.
- Projects. Keep related chats and files together. A file only goes to a cloud provider if you turn that on for that file.
- Personas. A writing coach, a study buddy, a devil's advocate, or just a good listener.
- Briefings. A daily, tomorrow, or weekly summary of what's coming up.
- Your Mac, from your phone. Pick up a chat that's running on your Mac. The Mac does the work, and your keys stay there.
- Widgets and Siri Shortcuts for starting a chat in one tap.

record.name: ArchiLens: Architecture ID
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Point your phone at a building. Learn what it is, and why.

ArchiLens recognises 67 architectural styles — from Ancient Egyptian to Brutalism, from Anatolian Seljuk to Bauhaus — and explains what you are looking at in plain language. Everything runs on your device: no account, no ads, no internet needed.

WHAT ONE PHOTO GIVES YOU
• The style, with the model's confidence shown openly
• Style DNA — the details that gave it away: pointed arches, whiplash curves, board-marked concrete
• Period and tradition, placed on a 5,000-year timeline
• Famous examples with architects and locations
• A side-by-side comparison with the style it is most often confused with

67 STYLES ACROSS 13 TRADITIONS
Ancient · Medieval European · Renaissance & Baroque · Neoclassical & Revival · Victorian & American Residential · Islamic Architecture · Traditional Asian · Early Modern Transition · Modernism · Late 20th Century · Contemporary · Socialist Era · Vernacular

The Islamic family alone holds 10 sub-styles — Anatolian Seljuk, Beylik, Classical and Late Ottoman, Mamluk, Mughal and more — a level of detail general-purpose image apps do not attempt.
Early Modern Transition · Modernism · Late 20th Century · Contemporary · Socialist Era · Vernacular

The Islamic family alone holds 10 sub-styles — Anatolian Seljuk, Begeneral-purpose image apps do not attempt.

AI THAT ADMITS WHAT IT DOESN'T KNOW
Most recognition apps guess confidently and are quietly wrong. ArchiLens shows its score. When it cannot separate two close styles, it says so: you get the tradition it is confident about, the closest candidates ranked, and the full knowledge card for the leading one — clearly marked as a candidate, not a verdict. It also suggests how to reshoot for a clearer answer.

A LIBRARY WORTH GETTING LOST IN
All 67 styles, browsable offline, searchable by name, period or feature in four languages. Every style has a card: how to recognise it, numbered distinctive elements, famous buildings, and a world map of surviving examples.

DISCOVERY PASSPORT
Each style you identify becomes a stamp. Complete a tradition to earn its badge, climb seven explorer ranks, and keep a private map of where you found what — stored only on your phone.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Photos are analysed on the device and never uploaded. No account, no analytics, no ads, no data collection. The only network requests are the optional style maps and the Nearby feature, which asks the public Wikimedia service for notable buildings around you and stores nothing.

Available in English, Türkçe, Italiano and Deutsch.

For travellers, students, architecture lovers, and anyone who has stopped in the street and wondered: what IS that building?

Whether you’re a professional interior designer who wants quick home/room/house design ideas to pitch your client or anyone who wants to renovate their space. Interia’s the ultimate solution for your design planning needs.

Interia’s AI model has been trained by professional interior designers using more than 75000+ home, room, and house plans, making it highly efficient.

How to use Interia?


• Launch the app
• Add one picture of your room/space (Make sure there are not many obstructions, avoid human beings/pets etc, in the room when you capture)
• Choose the type of room: Bedroom, Living Room, Gaming Room, Kitchen, etc.
• Choose from 5 Interior design styles: Minimal, Modern, Professional, Tropical, Vintage
• Voila, you’ll see 4 different interior design ideas that can be done on your room.

Note: The results generated are for reference purposes, you can visualize the room in different styles and layouts. As of now, the app doesn’t allow you to change the size/place of the items such as sofas, TVs, beds, etc, but will soon support it in the future.

Once you feel that the layout is decent enough and the placement of TV, sofas, tables, beds, etc is perfect, you can ask your designer to make designs accordingly.
